items.name: Captures concrete observations
items.description: The note records specific observed behaviors rather than vague impressions.

anchors.score_0: No concrete observations; only generalities or judgments.
anchors.score_1: Some observations but mixed with vague language or missing specifics.
anchors.score_2: Multiple specific, behavioral observations grounded in what was seen or heard.

items.name: Balances inquiry and assertion
items.description: The note reflects two-way dialogue rather than a one-sided directive.

anchors.score_0: Entirely directive; no questions or solicitation of the other party's view.
anchors.score_1: Mostly directive with occasional surface-level questions.
anchors.score_2: Clear back-and-forth: substantive questions paired with thoughtful assertions.

items.name: Specifies next steps with owners
items.description: Concrete actions are captured with named owners and timeframes.

anchors.score_0: No next steps, or vague aspirations without owners.
anchors.score_1: Next steps named but missing owners or timeframes.
anchors.score_2: Specific actions, named owners, and clear timeframes.

items.name: Links to prior commitments
items.description: Follows up on or references commitments from previous conversations.

anchors.score_0: No reference to anything prior; treated as standalone.
anchors.score_1: Acknowledges a prior topic but does not engage with what was committed.
anchors.score_2: Explicitly revisits prior commitments and discusses progress against them.

items.name: Checks for understanding
items.description: Confirms alignment before moving on or closing the discussion.

anchors.score_1: Asks a yes/no confirmation without inviting elaboration.
anchors.score_2: Invites the other party to restate or expand on the agreement.

items.name: Summarizes outcomes
items.description: Closes with an explicit summary of what was discussed and decided.

anchors.score_1: Brief mention of one outcome without full recap.
anchors.score_2: Clear summary of topics covered, decisions made, and open items.
